format.stability: codes are public API: never renamed or reused; new codes may be added
format.whereTheyAppear: errorReason in PAYMENT-RESPONSE, invalidReason / errorReason in facilitator answers, error in JSON error bodies, and the code of errors a client raises (group client codes never go on the wire)
format.unknownCodes: a client that receives an errorReason it does not know treats it as payment_rejected

the payment is under dispute (MED)

the merchant token sent to the facilitator is missing or wrong
too many charges created for this client or merchant
